title: Hearty Canadian Scamorza Gratin
description: A rustic Canadian gratin featuring creamy scamorza, tender potatoes, and a sprinkle of bonito-shave for a springy finish.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and lightly butter a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Arrange a layer of thinly sliced potatoes across the bottom of the dish, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Place a layer of scamorza slices over the potatoes, leaving a small border around the edges.
Drizzle heavy cream evenly over the cheese, then sprinkle minced garlic and diced butter on top.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a final layer of scamorza.
Sprinkle bonito-shave evenly over the top layer of cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot as a comforting dinner for four.
